question: Should CodexBar accept forwarding the full longcat.chat cookie jar to LongCat’s own console endpoints for this provider?
rationale: The authentication cookie name is undocumented, so the implementation deliberately sends every domain cookie and only repository maintainers can accept that privacy and credential boundary.

options.title: Accept with guardrails
options.body: Allow full-cookie forwarding because it stays on LongCat’s HTTPS origin, remains disabled by default, uses Chrome-only automatic import, and avoids logging sensitive account responses.

options.title: Require narrower credentials
options.body: Hold the provider until LongCat documents a specific cookie, token, or usage API that permits a narrower credential boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept with guardrails
recommendation.body: Allow full-cookie forwarding because it stays on LongCat’s HTTPS origin, remains disabled by default, uses Chrome-only automatic import, and avoids logging sensitive account responses.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared provider-framework and cookie-auth history makes this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
